[[File:Lucky_Lancer.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Lucky Lancer'']]
{{Quote|The Lucky Lancer is the most famous Corellian ship in the galaxy! We can't just blow it up to clear a parking spot!|Locke|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Lucky Lancer''''' was a [[Rendaran-class assault shuttle|''Rendaran''-class assault shuttle]] famous for surviving over one hundred combat missions during the [[Great Galactic War]]. It was later stored in the [[Corellian Museum of Starships]]. While General [[Elin Garza]] reccomended destroying the ''Lancer'' to clear the landing pad it was parked on, the Corellians instead had [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Meteor,]] the commander of [[Havoc Squad]], escort them inside the Museum so they could fly the ship elsewhere.
